Requirement The target carries at least one mutation.

Range 30 feet

Attempt a Nature check against the target's Will DC, or simply succeed against a willing target. On a success, you learn how many Slots the target's mutations occupy, the Gift and Tithe of one mutation of your choice among them, and roughly how close the target is running to their Strain limit — thin, straining, or overflowing. Mutation is just growth that grew somewhere it wasn't planted, and you've spent a career reading growth.
